home.aboutIntro: Hello, I graduated from Guangdong Food and Drug Vocational College, majoring in Health Information Management. I am good at managing data and turning it into decision-supporting information. In this era of big data and AI, I believe valuable information is the foundation of data operations and decision-making.
home.aboutPoint1: ● My name is <u>Yang Zitong</u>. I master HTML/CSS/JS and Python and other development tools.
home.aboutPoint2: ● Detail-oriented, and keen on exploring human-machine interaction to make products warmer.
home.aboutPoint3: ● Currently building web apps with Vue and modern CSS, and continuously learning backend technologies.
home.aboutPoint4: ● Also able to manage data with Python, MySQL and other tools.
home.aboutPoint5: ● I believe that clean, clear and warm code creates better products.
